evaluator: Codex visual inspection of actual tool output and six canonical assets, 2026-10-26

linework.observation: Dark clean contours consistently outline person, pipes and consoles.

colour.observation: Officer skin reads warm orange tan rather than the requested medium brown.

shading.observation: Clothing uses broad cel-shadow regions; background panels remain illustrated.

character_construction.observation: Eyes have large white sclera and realistic nose/lip construction unlike small solid dark ovals and button nose.

backgrounds.observation: Map and panel wear introduce overly fine texture and dense marks.

finish.observation: Mixed facial construction and detailed map do not match the canonical series throughout.

identity.observation: Protagonist absent; a distinct supporting woman appears.

content.observation: Hair is tied into a bun rather than requested short curls. No Roman or kitchen objects are visible.

composition.observation: Officer, chart console and watertight door are clearly arranged in wide interior.

regions.people_faces: White eye areas, smaller nose and outlined lips deviate from oval-eye button-nose construction.
regions.clothing: Navy coveralls are appropriate and cel shaded.
regions.architecture: Pipes and watertight door fit this production; panel scuffs are unnecessary.
regions.lighting: Cool practical lights appropriate; no major cinematic glow.

correction: Give the distinct female officer small SOLID DARK OVAL eyes with no white sclera or iris, small rounded button nose, simple single-curve mouth and rounded face construction matching reference. Keep her medium-brown skin distinctly darker than warm-tan protagonist. Short black curls ending above the neck, no bun. Keep navy coveralls and modern submarine. Replace map microdetail with five broad route lines; remove panel scuffs, grain and tiny texture. Preserve readable equipment with simplified outlined shapes.
